C0671.title: Abuse of '7-Day No-Reason Return' Policy: How to Curb the 'Wool-Gathering' Chaos?
C0671.summary: In May 2026, luxury brands Saint Laurent and Miu Miu were reported to have imposed shipping restrictions on certain streets in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, due to excessive malicious returns. Reports indicate these incidents reflect some consumers abusing the '7-day no-reason return' rule, exposing a lack of industry integrity and a breakdown in rule balance.

references.title: 'Seven-Day Unconditional Returns' Abused: How to Curb the 'Wool-Gathering' Chaos? | Tencent News
